title: Aether Forge Agent Config (aether-forge.json)
description: Per-agent runtime configuration baked at generation time by `forge generate-fast`. Read by every CLI command that resolves planner / runtime / memory settings. Permissive on unknown top-level keys so user-managed sections (e.g. `mcp_servers`, `adapters`) can extend the contract without breaking validation; strict on the v0.21.0+ provenance fields the framework writes itself.

deploymentProfile.description: Risk tier the agent will run under (v0.22.0+, FP-2 deepening). `local` (default) tolerates autodetected planners and heuristic fallback; `staging` requires explicit planner; `production` is strict — `forge doctor` fails when planner.source=autodetected or planner.mode=heuristic.

mode.description: Planner backend. `heuristic` is the safe fallback (no LLM); the cloud modes (`anthropic`/`openai`/`gemini`/`openrouter`) and `ollama` are LLM-driven; `function-call` and `openai-compatible` are pluggable provider shims; `static` reads a fixture file (test only).

apiKey.description: Direct API key (prefer apiKeyEnv in committed configs).

apiKeyEnv.description: Name of the env var that holds the API key.

staticResponseFile.description: Path to a JSON file for the static planner mode.

source.description: Provenance of the planner choice (v0.21.0+). `explicit` = operator passed `--planner-mode` or set `AETHER_FORGE_PLANNER_MODE`; `autodetected` = `cli._autodetect_planner` picked it.

detectedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which autodetect ran. Present only when source=autodetected.

toolMode.description: When true, the planner uses provider-native tool-use (Anthropic tool_use / OpenAI function_calling) instead of string-parsed JSON. Sprint 2.1 / FP-1 deepening. Default false.
